## Glossary

**AppShell / FullscreenLayout**  
The two authenticated layouts: the shell with sidebar and header, or a full-screen page without it.

**_authenticated**  
Layout route: requireAuth + AppShell + nav-based access check.

**Component-less redirect parent**  
A route segment with children is a grouping with an index page, never a component parent above its children.

**file-based routing**  
TanStack Router scans app/routes and generates a type-safe route tree (bun run generate:routes).

**frontend-routing**  
Class: the three frontend apps, their file routes, layouts and app shells.

**_fullscreen**  
Layout route: requireAuth + FullscreenLayout without AppShell, for invoices, previews, print, embeds, focused flows.

**index route**  
Where a page moves when its segment gains children (bots/index.tsx + bots/$id.tsx).

**_public**  
Layout route for unauthenticated pages (login, signup, auth.callback).

**redirectPreservingContext**  
Throws a beforeLoad redirect keeping org, space and spoof params.

**redirectTo**  
Search param the guard sets so login/signup return the user to the original path.

**requireAuth / requirePublic**  
beforeLoad guards from @template/ui/guards built by createAuthGuards; both run auth.initialize() first.

**__root**  
Root route: registers nav config (useRegisterNavigation), page meta, theme, websocket and FlowBanner once.

**web / admin / superadmin**  
The three frontend apps: consumer/participant, operator, and platform-operations (user-context first, locked selector).

## 1. What this Warden covers

The three frontend apps (web, admin, superadmin) and how a page gets a URL: TanStack file routes under each app's app/routes, the four layout groups, guards in beforeLoad, and the shared pages in `@template/ui` that thin route files mount. Nav config, permission-gated items and tenant context switching are the `navigation` region.

## 2. The domain

The apps share one architecture and differ by perspective (APPS.md, FRONTEND.md): web is for participating, admin for operating organizations and spaces, superadmin for the platform (user and public contexts only, ContextSelector locked, no spoof controls). Each app holds only thin route files, its nav config, main.tsx and a logger; pages (`HomePage`, `ProfilePage`, `UserProfilePage`, `SpaceProfilePage`, `OrganizationsPage`, `OrganizationUsersPage`, `SegmentsPage`, `SignupPage`), layouts, hooks, guards and the store live in @template/ui. Routes are TanStack file routes under app/routes (`bun run generate:routes` regenerates the tree) with four layout groups: `__root` (registers nav config, page meta, theme, websocket, FlowBanner), `_public` (no auth; login, signup), `_authenticated` (requireAuth + `AppShell` + nav-based access check; settings as nested routes) and `_fullscreen` (requireAuth + `FullscreenLayout`, no AppShell). Guards run in beforeLoad; redirects there use `redirectPreservingContext`, and `navigateToLogin` / `navigateToSignup` keep redirectTo. A segment with children becomes a component-less grouping with an index page, never a component parent above children. `currentPath` / `currentLocation` read the router outside components.

Not here: the nav config, `NavItem.access`, `useAuthenticatedRouting`, `findRoute`, breadcrumbs and tenant context switching are `navigation`; the store and slices are `frontend-store`; the SDK and query hooks are `api-client`; AppShell's layout system, Page, Modal and theme tokens are `theme-layout` and `ui-components`; login forms and the OAuth callback are `frontend-auth`.

### Class `frontend-routing`: The three frontend apps, file routes, layouts and app shells

**Job: choose which route layout group a page lives under** (Route layout groups (web; admin and superadmin mirror them)) — docs/claude/FRONTEND/ROUTING_NAVIGATION.md § File-Based Routes

*Said as:* "which folder does this page go in", "does this page need login", "a page without the sidebar", "where do signed-out pages live", "which layout group for this route"

| Member | Use when | Not when (use instead) |
|---|---|---|
| **apps/web/app/routes/__root** | app-wide providers and shell | signed-in-only layout (use _authenticated) |
| **apps/web/app/routes/_authenticated** | pages requiring a signed-in user | app-wide wrapping (__root); signed-out pages (_public) |
| **apps/web/app/routes/_public** | signed-out pages | signed-in pages (use _authenticated) |
| **apps/web/app/routes/_fullscreen** | chromeless pages: invoices, previews, print, embeds | signed-in pages with the shell (use _authenticated) |

**Job: redirect or navigate while keeping tenant context** (Redirects and navigation that keep context) — ROUTING_NAVIGATION.md § Guards; FRONTEND/AUTH.md § Navigation Helpers

*Said as:* "redirect without losing the org and space", "send them to login and bring them back", "I'll build the redirect url with the params", "which redirect helper do I use here"

| Member | Use when | Not when (use instead) |
|---|---|---|
| **redirectPreservingContext** | any redirect inside route beforeLoad | auth redirects carrying redirectTo (use navigateToLogin / navigateToSignup) |
| **navigateToLogin** | linking from signup to login, preserveSearch true | the reverse (use navigateToSignup) |
| **navigateToSignup** | linking from login to signup, preserveSearch true | the reverse (use navigateToLogin) |
| **navigatePreserving** | in-app navigation that must keep tenant context | beforeLoad redirects (use redirectPreservingContext) |

**Job: gate a page or action on auth and permissions** (Gating: guards vs nav access vs permissions.check) — FEATURES.md § Route Guards; FRONTEND.md § Conventions

*Said as:* "who can see this page or button", "gate the page on permission", "I'll check the role in the component", "hide the action for users without access", "where does the auth check go"

| Member | Use when | Not when (use instead) |
|---|---|---|
| **requireAuth (auth-middleware-users)** | beforeLoad guard for signed-in routes | logged-out-only pages (use requirePublic) |
| **requirePublic (auth-middleware-users)** | login/signup pages | signed-in routes (use requireAuth) |
| **nav config access** | page-level gating | action-level gating (use permissions.check) |
| **permissions.check** | gating actions in components | gating whole pages (use nav config access) |

  - *Said as:* "read shared app state from any component", "the one store all three apps use", "I'll make a new store for this app", "get it right from the context instead of passing it"
- **Context-preserving redirects** · rule docs/claude/FRONTEND/ROUTING_NAVIGATION.md § Routing › Guards · code: `requireAuth`, `AppShell`, `FullscreenLayout`, `redirectPreservingContext`: every beforeLoad redirect
  - *Said as:* "every guard redirect must keep org and space", "I'll redirect without the search params", "don't lose the tenant on redirect"
- **Guards run in beforeLoad** · rule FEATURES.md > Frontend Architecture > Route Guards: Any route that needs auth gating.
  - *Said as:* "check auth before the route loads", "I'll check auth in an effect and redirect", "where does the auth gate go"
- **No app component folders** · rule docs/claude/APPS.md Component Organization: Adding any frontend component, hook or page
  - *Said as:* "where do I put this component", "I'll add a components folder to the app", "components live in the shared ui package, not apps"
- **No component parent above child routes** · rule docs/claude/FRONTEND/ROUTING_NAVIGATION.md § Routing › Routes With Children · code: `requireAuth`, `AppShell`, `FullscreenLayout`, `redirectPreservingContext`: any route gaining nested children; leaf routes stay flat files like bots.tsx
  - *Said as:* "the detail route renders the list instead of the record", "I'll keep the list component on the parent and add a child route", "a route gaining children must become a layout, not a page"
  - *Signs you're bypassing it:* a bots.tsx with a component alongside bots.$id.tsx, so /bots/:id renders the list instead of the detail (docs/claude/FRONTEND/ROUTING_NAVIGATION.md § Routes With Children (never leave a component parent above children))
- **No context header to API** · rule docs/claude/APPS.md State Management: Any API call scoped to an org or space
  - *Said as:* "I'll add an org header to every request", "how does the api know the current org or space", "scope the call to the tenant without a custom header"
- **No hand-rolled role checks on frontend** · rule docs/claude/FRONTEND.md > Conventions: Any page or action visibility decision in frontend apps
  - *Said as:* "I'll check if the user is admin before showing this", "comparing role strings in a component", "don't branch on the role name in ui"
  - *Signs you're bypassing it:* comparing user.role / organizationUser.role strings in components to show pages or actions instead of nav access and permissions.check (docs/claude/FRONTEND.md § Conventions (don't hand-roll role checks))
- **One shared store, no per-app store** · rule docs/claude/FRONTEND.md > Conventions: Any new frontend state in web, admin or superadmin
  - *Said as:* "I'll create a store just for this app", "a react context for app state", "all three apps share one store"
  - *Signs you're bypassing it:* a new create() Zustand store, React context provider or app-specific slice inside apps/web, apps/admin or apps/superadmin (docs/claude/FRONTEND.md § State Management; docs/claude/ZUSTAND.md § Best Practices (DON'T create app-specific slices or per-app stores))
- **Protect layouts with guards** · rule docs/claude/FRONTEND.md > Conventions: Every layout route needing auth state gating
  - *Said as:* "put the auth gate on the layout, not each page", "I'll guard every page individually", "the layout route carries the guard"
- **Shared Zustand store** · rule docs/claude/ZUSTAND.md: Any frontend state in web, admin or superadmin
  - *Said as:* "any frontend state goes in the shared store", "where do I keep client state", "I'll keep this in a module variable"
- **Superadmin is user-context first** · rule docs/claude/FRONTEND.md > Conventions: Any context-dependent feature built for superadmin
  - *Said as:* "superadmin shouldn't need an org selected", "I'll require an org for this superadmin feature", "superadmin works at the user level"
  - *Signs you're bypassing it:* superadmin features that force or require an organization/space context (docs/claude/FRONTEND.md § Conventions)
- **Superadmin locked context** · rule apps/superadmin _authenticated.tsx: Superadmin app layouts
  - *Said as:* "the context selector is locked in superadmin", "no org or space switching in the platform app", "non-superadmins see unauthorized there"
- **Tenant context in search params** · rule docs/claude/FRONTEND/ROUTING_NAVIGATION.md § Routing › File-Based Routes · code: `requireAuth`, `AppShell`, `FullscreenLayout`, `redirectPreservingContext`: any route needing org, space, spoof or flow context
  - *Said as:* "org and space ride in the query string", "I'll put the org id in the url path", "why isn't the tenant part of the path"
  - *Signs you're bypassing it:* route paths like /org/$orgId/settings that put tenant context in the path (docs/claude/FRONTEND/ROUTING_NAVIGATION.md § File-Based Routes (tenant context is not in the path))
- **Thin app routes, shared UI in @template/ui** · rule docs/claude/FRONTEND.md > Conventions: Any page or component reused or potentially reused across apps
  - *Said as:* "the route file only mounts the page", "I'll write the page logic in the route file", "pages reused across apps belong in the shared package"

## 4. The specifics, in full

### 4a. Doc sections

Each unit is the doc section verbatim, with its headings shifted down two levels. A source line above it gives the path, the section and the doc's H1.

<!-- unit doc:docs/claude/APPS.md#the-three-apps -->
**Source:** `docs/claude/APPS.md` § The Three Apps (in "App Structure")

#### The Three Apps

##### Web - Consumer/End-User Interface
- **Who**: End users, consumers, participants
- **Purpose**: Browse, participate, consume content
- **Context**: Personal/Organization/Space (as a participant)

##### Admin - Provider/Operator Interface
- **Who**: Space operators, marketplace managers, content providers
- **Purpose**: Manage spaces, content, and operations
- **Context**: Personal/Organization/Space (as an operator)

##### Superadmin - Platform Operations
- **Who**: Platform team (you)
- **Purpose**: Manage entire platform, system health, all customers
- **Context**: User context only; the ContextSelector is rendered locked (`<AppShell lockedContext showSpoofControls={false}>`)
- Non-superadmins get `<Unauthorized />` from its `_authenticated.tsx` layout

<!-- unit doc:docs/claude/APPS.md#key-insight -->
**Source:** `docs/claude/APPS.md` § Key Insight (in "App Structure")

#### Key Insight

**All three apps share the same multi-tenant architecture:**
- One shared store, AppShell, guards and permission system (Permix/ReBAC)
- Web and Admin let the user switch Personal/Organization/Space in the ContextSelector
- Each app has its own nav config (`apps/{app}/app/config/nav/`)

**The difference is perspective, not structure:**
- Web = consuming/participating in spaces
- Admin = operating/managing spaces
- Superadmin = managing the platform itself

<!-- unit doc:docs/claude/APPS.md#frontend-architecture-overview -->
**Source:** `docs/claude/APPS.md` § Frontend Architecture Overview (in "App Structure")

#### Frontend Architecture Overview

All three apps share common frontend infrastructure. See [FRONTEND.md](FRONTEND.md) for comprehensive details.

**Shared Stack:**
- **Router**: TanStack Router with file-based routing and guards
- **State**: Zustand with 6 slices (Client, Auth, Navigation, Permissions, Tenant, UI); see [ZUSTAND.md](ZUSTAND.md)
- **Auth**: BetterAuth with bearer tokens
- **Permissions**: Permix/ReBAC integrated into frontend state
- **UI**: Shared component library, hooks, pages and store in `@template/ui`
- **API**: Generated client `@template/sdk` (hey-api, OpenAPI) with optimistic mutations

**App-Specific Differences:**
- Navigation configs (different routes/menus per app)
- Context selector behavior (switchable vs locked)
- Permission-gated features

<!-- unit doc:docs/claude/APPS.md#example -->
**Source:** `docs/claude/APPS.md` § Example (in "App Structure")

#### Example

**Acme** is an organization with a space, **Acme Events**.

**Admin Flow:**
- An Acme operator logs into **Admin**
- Switches context to "Acme Events"
- Manages the space's members, settings and content

**Web Flow:**
- A member logs into **Web**
- Switches between the organizations and spaces they belong to
- Participates in Acme Events as a member

**Superadmin Flow:**
- Platform team logs into **Superadmin**
- No context switching (platform-level)
- Views all organizations and users

<!-- unit doc:docs/claude/APPS.md#implementation-notes -->
**Source:** `docs/claude/APPS.md` § Implementation Notes (in "App Structure")

#### Implementation Notes

**Shared Infrastructure:**
- All three apps render the shared `AppShell` (ContextSelector, Sidebar, UserMenu); superadmin locks the selector and hides spoof controls
- Auth guards (`requireAuth`, `requirePublic` from `@template/ui/guards`) and public pages are shared
- Nav configs differ based on app purpose (see [Navigation](FRONTEND/ROUTING_NAVIGATION.md#navigation))

**State & Routing:**
- All apps use the same shared Zustand store (6 slices)
- TanStack Router with guards (`requireAuth`, `requirePublic`)
- Permission checks integrated at route (nav `access`) and component level
- Context switching logic (`useAuthenticatedRouting`) shared by all apps

**Component Organization:**
- `@template/ui` - components, hooks, pages, store and guards shared by all apps
- `@template/sdk` - generated API client
- Apps hold routes, nav config, `main.tsx` and `app/lib/logger.ts`; they have no component folders of their own

**For comprehensive frontend details**, see [FRONTEND.md](FRONTEND.md).

<!-- unit doc:docs/claude/FRONTEND.md#stack -->
**Source:** `docs/claude/FRONTEND.md` § Stack (in "Frontend Architecture")

#### Stack

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Apps: web, admin, superadmin                │
│ ├─ TanStack Router (file routes)            │
│ ├─ Nav config (app/config/nav)              │
│ └─ Thin routes mounting @template/ui pages  │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ Shared Packages                             │
│ ├─ @template/sdk (generated client, types)  │
│ └─ @template/ui (components, hooks, store,  │
│    pages, guards)                           │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

**All three apps share:**
- TanStack Router (file-based routing)
- One Zustand store, `useAppStore` from `@template/ui/store`
- BetterAuth client with bearer tokens
- ReBAC permission checks (Permix) in the permissions slice
- `@template/ui` components and pages

<!-- unit doc:docs/claude/FRONTEND.md#app-differences -->
**Source:** `docs/claude/FRONTEND.md` § App Differences (in "Frontend Architecture")

#### App Differences

| Feature | Web | Admin | Superadmin |
|---------|-----|-------|------------|
| **ContextSelector** | ✅ Yes | ✅ Yes | Locked |
| **Multi-tenant** | ✅ Yes | ✅ Yes | ❌ No (user + public contexts only) |
| **Spoof controls** | ✅ Yes | ✅ Yes | ❌ No |
| **Navigation** | Consumer actions | Operator actions | Platform management |
| **Nav Config** | `apps/web/app/config/nav/` | `apps/admin/app/config/nav/` | `apps/superadmin/app/config/nav/` |
| **Store** | shared `useAppStore` | shared `useAppStore` | shared `useAppStore` (user-context first) |

**Web (Consumer):** dashboard, organizations, spaces, users, segments, inquiries, settings.

**Admin (Operator):** the same set without segments, for operators of organizations and spaces.

**Superadmin (Platform):** dashboard, all organizations and users, platform inquiries, settings.

More on the apps: [APPS.md](APPS.md).

<!-- unit doc:docs/claude/FRONTEND.md#conventions -->
**Source:** `docs/claude/FRONTEND.md` § Conventions (in "Frontend Architecture")

#### Conventions

- Compose state as store slices; never add a per-app store ([ZUSTAND.md](ZUSTAND.md)).
- Web and admin are tenant-context aware; superadmin is user-context first and never forces a tenant.
- Gate pages through the nav config's `access` and actions through `permissions.check`; don't hand-roll role checks. Platform `superadmin` bypasses checks in the permissions slice.
- Protect layouts with `requireAuth` / `requirePublic` from `@template/ui/guards`.
- Put shared UI and pages in `@template/ui`; app routes stay thin.

<!-- unit doc:docs/claude/FRONTEND/ROUTING_NAVIGATION.md#routing -->
**Source:** `docs/claude/FRONTEND/ROUTING_NAVIGATION.md` § Routing (in "Frontend Routing and Navigation")

#### Routing

##### File-Based Routes

```
apps/web/app/routes/
├── __root.tsx              # Registers nav config, page meta, theme, websocket, FlowBanner
├── _public.tsx             # Public layout (no auth)
├── _public/
│   ├── index.tsx
│   ├── login.tsx
│   ├── signup.tsx
│   └── auth.callback.tsx   # OAuth callback
├── _authenticated.tsx      # requireAuth + AppShell + nav-based access check
├── _authenticated/
│   ├── dashboard.tsx
│   ├── settings.tsx        # Redirects /settings → /settings/profile
│   ├── settings/           # profile, tokens, webhooks, integrations, authProviders, update, transfer
│   └── …
├── _fullscreen.tsx         # requireAuth + FullscreenLayout (no AppShell)
└── _fullscreen/
    └── example.tsx
```

Admin and superadmin follow the same layout set.

**Layout Types:**

- **`_public`** - Public pages, no authentication
- **`_authenticated`** - Protected pages with AppShell (sidebar + header)
- **`_fullscreen`** - Protected pages without AppShell (back button only)

**Fullscreen Layout Use Cases:**
- Invoice/receipt views
- Document previews
- Print layouts
- Embedded views
- Focused workflows (onboarding, surveys)

`FullscreenLayout`'s back button calls `navigatePreserving('..', 'context')`, so org/space/spoof survive the trip back.

Tenant context is not in the path. It rides in search params (`?org=`, `?space=`, `?spoof=`, `?flow=`); `useAuthenticatedRouting` syncs them into the store and back.

##### Routes With Children

A route file with a `component` becomes the **parent layout** of any nested routes (`bots.tsx` is the parent of `bots.$id.tsx`). TanStack mounts the parent and slots children into its `<Outlet/>` — so a list page sitting at `bots.tsx` swallows its own detail route (`/bots/:id` renders the list, never the detail) unless it renders an `<Outlet/>`.

Rule:

- **Leaf route** (no children) → flat file: `bots.tsx`.
- **Route with children** → the page at that path moves to an **index**, and the segment becomes a pure grouping with no component-bearing parent:
  ```
  bots/
    index.tsx   # list   → /bots
    $id.tsx     # detail → /bots/$id
  ```
  Equivalent flat form: `bots.index.tsx` + `bots.$id.tsx` (no `bots.tsx`).

Never leave a `bots.tsx` with a `component` sitting above children. A component-less parent is only for shared layout or redirects (e.g. `settings.tsx` and `segments.tsx` redirect to a default child) and renders children via TanStack's default `<Outlet/>`.

##### Segments navigation

Segments uses the existing nested sidebar pattern: **Owned** (`/segments/owned`) and
**Memberships** (`/segments/memberships`) under `/segments`, in user, organization and space
contexts. The parent redirects to Owned through `redirectPreservingContext`; it has no page
component that could swallow the children. Both routes render `SegmentsPage` with an explicit
`view`, and only that view's query is enabled. See [SEGMENTS.md](../SEGMENTS.md#web-navigation).

##### Guards

**Location:** `packages/ui/src/guards/`

`createAuthGuards(getStore)` (`authGuard.ts`) returns two `beforeLoad` guards. Both run `auth.initialize()` first.

- `requireAuth` — unauthenticated → redirect to `/login` with `redirectTo` (path + search + hash) and the `org` / `space` / `spoof` params carried over.
- `requirePublic` — authenticated → redirect to `redirectTo` or `/dashboard`.

`appGuards.ts` binds them to the shared store; apps import them directly:

```typescript
import { requireAuth } from '@template/ui/guards';

export const Route = createFileRoute('/_authenticated')({
  beforeLoad: (ctx) => requireAuth(ctx),
  component: AuthenticatedLayout,
});
```

Redirects inside `beforeLoad` use `redirectPreservingContext(ctx, to)` (`@template/ui/lib`), which keeps `org` / `space` / `spoof`.

- ✅ **Auth flows** - Login, signup, OAuth callback fully functional across all apps

- 🟡 **Admin App** (`apps/admin/`) - Dashboard, organizations, communications, users, settings pages exist as placeholders

<!-- unit doc:FEATURES.md#frontend-architecture -->
**Source:** `FEATURES.md` § Frontend Architecture (in "Template Features")

#### Frontend Architecture

**Modern React Stack with Type Safety** - React 19 + TypeScript 5.9, TanStack Router v1 for file-based routing, TanStack Query v5 for server state, Zustand for client state. Vite 7 for lightning-fast builds, Tailwind CSS 4 for styling.

- ✅ React 19 + TypeScript 5.9
- ✅ **File-Based Routing** - TanStack Router scans `app/routes/` directory and generates type-safe route tree. Routes colocated with page components. Nested layouts via `__root.tsx` and `_authenticated.tsx`. Automatic code splitting per route for optimal bundle sizes

- ✅ **Declarative Navigation System** - Navigation config files organized by context (user/org/space/public) and feature (dashboard/settings/communications). Each nav item declares path, label, icon, and required permissions. Menu items automatically filtered based on user permissions and current context. Config reusable across web/admin/superadmin apps with context-specific overrides

- ✅ **Context-Aware Routing** - Routes automatically include current context params (`?org=`, `?space=`). Navigate to organization settings and URL becomes `/settings?org=orgId`. Switch organizations and all links update automatically. `getContextParams()` generates params for any route based on current state

- ✅ **Zustand State Management** - Six slices manage different concerns: **auth** (user/session), **tenant** (org/space), **permissions** (RBAC/ReBAC cache), **navigation** (breadcrumbs/menu state), **ui** (theme/modals/toasts), **client** (API base URL/headers). Slice factories enable testing without circular dependencies

- ✅ **Server State Caching** - TanStack Query v5 handles API response caching with smart invalidation. Auto-refetch on window focus, configurable stale times, request deduplication. Optimistic updates with automatic rollback on error maintain UI consistency

- ✅ **API Client Wrappers** - `apiQuery()` for GET requests unwraps nested `data.data` for clean usage. `apiMutation()` for mutations returns full response enabling optimistic update patterns. Both handle auth headers (session/token) and spoof headers (`x-spoof-user-email`) automatically

- ✅ **Route Guards** - `requireAuth()` redirects unauthenticated users to `/login?redirectTo=currentPath`. `requirePublic()` redirects authenticated users away from login/signup. Guards preserve context params across redirects. Execute in route `beforeLoad` for instant feedback before component renders

- ✅ **Vite Build System** - Lightning-fast HMR during development, optimized production builds with tree-shaking and code splitting. Supports workspace dependency hot reload via Turborepo watch mode

### 4b. Code entries

From the catalog (`.foundry/catalog/catalog.json`, extracted from the code). Each line: **name** `where` [kind] the job it does. Use: canonical usage.

#### Class `frontend-routing`
- **AppShell** `packages/ui/src/components/layout/AppShell.tsx#AppShell` [primitive] render the shared app frame with context selector, sidebar and user menu Use: <AppShell onSupport={...} lockedContext showSpoofControls={false}>…</AppShell>
- **currentLocation** `packages/ui/src/lib/currentLocation.ts#currentLocation` [primitive] read window pathname, search and hash safely, empty during SSR Use: const { pathname, search, hash } = currentLocation();
- **currentPath** `packages/ui/src/lib/currentLocation.ts#currentPath` [primitive] return the current pathname plus search and hash as one string Use: const path = currentPath();
- **FullscreenLayout** `packages/ui/src/components/layout/FullscreenLayout.tsx#FullscreenLayout` [primitive] render a full-page view whose back button keeps org, space and spoof context Use: <FullscreenLayout>{children}</FullscreenLayout>
- **HomePage** `packages/ui/src/pages/HomePage.tsx#HomePage` [primitive] render the landing page with project name, optional subtitle and signup link Use: <HomePage subtitle="..." showSignup={false} />
- **navigateToLogin** `packages/ui/src/lib/routeRedirect.ts#navigateToLogin` [primitive] send user to login, keeping redirectTo or current search and hash Use: navigateToLogin(getStore, true)
- **navigateToSignup** `packages/ui/src/lib/routeRedirect.ts#navigateToSignup` [primitive] send user to signup, keeping redirectTo or current search and hash Use: navigateToSignup(getStore, true)
- **OrganizationsPage** `packages/ui/src/pages/OrganizationsPage.tsx#OrganizationsPage` [primitive] list organizations the current user can access, gated by store permissions Use: <OrganizationsPage />
- **OrganizationUsersPage** `packages/ui/src/pages/OrganizationUsersPage.tsx#OrganizationUsersPage` [primitive] list an organization's users and open the invite modal Use: <OrganizationUsersPage organizationId={organizationId} />
- **ProfilePage** `packages/ui/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx#ProfilePage` [primitive] render the profile view matching the current tenant context type Use: <ProfilePage />
- **redirectPreservingContext** `packages/ui/src/lib/routeRedirect.ts#redirectPreservingContext` [primitive] redirect in beforeLoad while keeping org, space and spoof params Use: redirectPreservingContext(ctx, '/target')
- **SegmentsPage** `packages/ui/src/pages/SegmentsPage.tsx#SegmentsPage` [primitive] list segments owned by or containing the current context Use: <SegmentsPage view="owned" />  // or view="memberships"
- **SignupPage** `packages/ui/src/pages/SignupPage.tsx#SignupPage` [primitive] render the signup form with a link back to login Use: <SignupPage />
- **SpaceProfilePage** `packages/ui/src/pages/SpaceProfilePage.tsx#SpaceProfilePage` [primitive] show and edit the current space's profile Use: <SpaceProfilePage />
- **UserProfilePage** `packages/ui/src/pages/UserProfilePage.tsx#UserProfilePage` [primitive] show the signed-in user's profile loaded via meRead Use: <UserProfilePage />
- **bun run generate:routes** `package.json` [script] regenerate route trees for the web, admin and superadmin frontend apps Use: bun run generate:routes
- **apps/admin/app/routes/__root** `apps/admin/app/routes/__root` [system] define the admin app's root route and layout Use: apps/admin/app/routes/__root
- **apps/admin/app/routes/_authenticated** `apps/admin/app/routes/_authenticated` [system] gate admin routes behind authentication with a shared layout Use: place authenticated admin pages under apps/admin/app/routes/_authenticated/
- **apps/admin/app/routes/_authenticated/settings** `apps/admin/app/routes/_authenticated/settings` [system] manage profile, tokens, auth providers, integrations, webhooks and transfers in admin settings Use: add settings pages under apps/admin/app/routes/_authenticated/settings
- **apps/admin/app/routes/_fullscreen** `apps/admin/app/routes/_fullscreen` [system] wrap admin routes in a fullscreen layout without the standard shell Use: put fullscreen pages under apps/admin/app/routes/_fullscreen/
- **apps/admin/app/routes/_public** `apps/admin/app/routes/_public` [system] wrap admin routes reachable without authentication in a public layout Use: put unauthenticated pages under apps/admin/app/routes/_public/
- **apps/admin/app/routes/_public/login** `apps/admin/app/routes/_public/login` [system] render the admin app's public login page Use: route: apps/admin/app/routes/_public/login
- **apps/admin/app/routes/_public/signup** `apps/admin/app/routes/_public/signup` [system] render the admin app's public signup page Use: route: apps/admin/app/routes/_public/signup
- **apps/superadmin/app/routes/__root** `apps/superadmin/app/routes/__root` [system] define the superadmin app's root route and layout Use: edit apps/superadmin/app/routes/__root for app-wide superadmin layout
- **apps/superadmin/app/routes/_authenticated** `apps/superadmin/app/routes/_authenticated` [system] gate superadmin pages behind sign-in Use: place signed-in superadmin pages under apps/superadmin/app/routes/_authenticated
- **apps/superadmin/app/routes/_fullscreen** `apps/superadmin/app/routes/_fullscreen` [system] layout shell for superadmin routes rendered fullscreen without standard chrome Use: apps/superadmin/app/routes/_fullscreen/<page>
- **apps/superadmin/app/routes/_public** `apps/superadmin/app/routes/_public` [system] layout shell for superadmin routes reachable without signing in Use: apps/superadmin/app/routes/_public/<page>
- **apps/web/app/routes/__root** `apps/web/app/routes/__root` [system] root route wrapping every page of the web app Use: apps/web/app/routes/__root
- **apps/web/app/routes/_authenticated** `apps/web/app/routes/_authenticated` [system] layout shell gating web app routes behind sign-in Use: apps/web/app/routes/_authenticated/<page>
- **apps/web/app/routes/_authenticated/dashboard** `apps/web/app/routes/_authenticated/dashboard` [system] render the signed-in user's dashboard page in the web app Use: add dashboard pages under apps/web/app/routes/_authenticated/dashboard
- **apps/web/app/routes/_authenticated/settings** `apps/web/app/routes/_authenticated/settings` [system] host user settings: profile, auth providers, tokens, integrations, webhooks and transfers Use: add a settings page under apps/web/app/routes/_authenticated/settings
- **apps/web/app/routes/_fullscreen** `apps/web/app/routes/_fullscreen` [system] provide a fullscreen layout shell for routes without standard chrome Use: put fullscreen pages under apps/web/app/routes/_fullscreen/
- **apps/web/app/routes/_public** `apps/web/app/routes/_public` [system] provide the layout shell for routes reachable without signing in Use: put unauthenticated pages under apps/web/app/routes/_public/
- **apps/web/app/routes/_public/login** `apps/web/app/routes/_public/login` [system] render the public login page where users sign in Use: apps/web/app/routes/_public/login
- **apps/web/app/routes/_public/signup** `apps/web/app/routes/_public/signup` [system] render the public signup page where new users create accounts Use: apps/web/app/routes/_public/signup
